decision_conditions: Flat A and Flat B shall operate as separate children's homes and shall each accommodate no more than two resident children at any one time. The occupancy of one home shall not be used to increase the maximum occupancy of the other. The number of care staff based at, and operating from, each flat shall not exceed three members of staff at any one time (during staff shift handovers, the outgoing and incoming care staff may overlap for a period not exceeding 30 minutes), excluding a registered manager working during normal office hours, visiting professionals, social workers, healthcare practitioners, therapists, education providers, regulatory inspectors, maintenance personnel and other ancillary visitors.Flat A and B (separate) shall be used only as a children's care home (Use Class C2) and for no other purpose, including any other purpose within Class C2 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended), or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order, without the prior written permission of the Local Planning Authority.Reason: To ensure the development operates in accordance with the approved details and assessed level of    occupation, and in the interests of protecting residential amenity, maintaining the character of the area and minimising impacts on parking demand and highway safety.
description: Non material amendment to reference  26/01837/FUL to allow an overlap of staff not exceeding 30 minutes during shift handovers and to allow existing waste and recycling provision to continue without change.
